newsitem.title: MEXICO: U.S.'s Summers says tight Mexico borrowing needed.
newsitem.headline: U.S.'s Summers says tight Mexico borrowing needed.

text.p: Deputy U.S. Treasury Secretary Lawrence Summers on Monday said it was vital for Mexico to keep tight control on its public borrowing.

"Tight control on public borrowing is vital for Mexico for the same reason it is vital to the U.S. - because it is the single best way to support national savings and ensure that the fast growth we have seen in recent years can be sustained," he told the American Chamber of Commerce in Mexico.
He also praised Mexico for extending the maturities of its outstanding debt issues.

"I have also been pleased to see the Mexican government work to increase the horizon and maturity of its debt both internationally and domestically," he told reporters at a news conference after delivering his speech.
